title: Motor plate
about: A plate that holds a NEMA 17 stepper motor, the motor in most 3D printers: a 60 mm square with rounded corners, a 23 mm hole for the round boss on the motor's face, and four 3.4 mm holes 31 mm apart for its M3 screws.
picture_alt: A square plate with rounded corners, a big hole in the middle and four small holes round it
steps: sketch.constrain sketch=PlateSketch kind=length on=Line1 value=60 name=Width
sketch.constrain sketch=PlateSketch kind=length on=Line2 value=60 name=Height
sketch.constrain sketch=BoreSketch kind=radius on=Circle1 value=11.5 name=Bore

change.about: make the middle hole 24 mm across instead of 23 mm (BoreSketch's Bore), for a motor with a bigger boss.
